scope: Saved current critic local force audit on12 fixed fit contexts per arm. No parameter, joint-training or quality improvement claim.

completion.clock_scope: After report write/hash; deadline also checked after completion write.

limits: Local12fit contexts only; no held-out quality or full latent/time coverage.
Both common critics share an architectural family and cannot provide independent semantic accuracy truth.
Equal-norm residual-space directions do not establish parameter-Jacobian transfer, Adam displacement behavior or acquisition speed.
Changing tokenwise payoff also changes critic training gradients; a useful frozen direction is insufficient to establish coupled D/G improvement.
The tokenwise payoff does not repair every finite-critic origin force; fixed staleD nonstationarity is not a violation of joint GAN equilibrium.
Native per-context output-pooling and native KA2 input units are correct; this is a substantive experimental game law, not an established optimizer bug.
No output-MSE/RMSE objective, error-powered gate, rate/seed/head scan, quality run or structural control change.

Only saved clean FAST residuals are evaluated. Actual ownD trained with native per-site DV12; this audit does not estimate the perturbed training-force distribution or eliminate early-time noise effects.

software_checks.scope: CPU source-only mathematics/contracts; no actual checkpoint/quality run.

independent_review.scope: Qualified artifacts, exact numerical reductions, frozen input/owner checks and game-only decision; not a rerun of full-model acquisition.
